        tier: 2
    run-on-projects: []

        env:
            RUSTC_BOOTSTRAP: '1'

        variant: code-coverage-debug

            - builds/taskcluster_base_thunderbird.py
            - builds/releng_base_linux_64_builds.py
        custom-build-variant-cfg: code-coverage-debug
    use-sccache: false
    optimization:
        never: null
    fetches:
        toolchain:
            - linux64-libotr
            - linux64-grcov
            - linux64-rust-dev
            - sysroot-x86_64-linux-gnu
